topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The world flies swift as a falcon overhead, not stopping for us peasants bound to the soil. Your tale, traveler, makes the winds seem even swifter. To miss a moment you hold dear, such a cruel twist of fate! We, who toil under the sun, know well the struggle against forces beyond our control. The rains may come when we most fear them, or the drought linger when the earth cries out for water. But mark this, there is a kindness in the heavens, even in their meddling. Perhaps this delay, this unforeseen halt, carries a message from the saints, a whisper of purpose that we cannot yet see. May you find the heart to listen, and the strength to wait, for the wheel of fortune turns, and what seems lost today might yet find you in its own time.
